message.content:
# UI Description: Transit App (ChMetro/Bus App) — Pixel-Perfect Clone

## 1) Sections Top to Bottom

### A. Status Bar (top, over map)
- Left: time **"3:49"** (bold, white-ish with slight shadow), followed by app notification icons: an orange/white location icon, **Z** (Zomato, red), blue phone icon, blue icon, orange/green duo icon, and a white wrench/tool icon.
- Right: alarm clock icon, phone icon, **"3.60 KB/s"** with up/down arrows, **"4G"**, signal bars, Wi‑Fi icon, battery pill (mostly empty), **"56%"**.

### B. Map Controls (floating over map)
- **Top-left:** dark charcoal/black rounded pill (~radius 40px, ~48px tall) containing white bold text **"Stops"** + iOS-style toggle switch (blue #1A73E8 track, white knob on the right/on state).
- **Top-right:** white circular FAB (~52px) with black **"✕"** close icon.
- **Bottom-right (above sheet):** white circular FAB (~52px) with black **my-location / crosshair** icon.

### C. Map Area (full background)
- Google Maps light-style map. Road network in pale gray/white; major roads slightly darker gray with names:
  - Horizontal major road: **"Bharathi Salai"** (repeated label on right side), **"Ganghaa Chowk"** (left).
  - Vertical road: **"Anandam Nagar Main Rd"** (rotated ~-75°).
  - Diagonal streets: **"Bajanai Kovil St"**, **"Bajanai Kovil S"**, **"2nd Main St"**, **"Kannappan St"**, **"Sian St"**, **"5th Cross St"**, **"6th St"**, **"1st St"** (×2), **"8th Ave"**, **"Anna St"** (rotated), **"Natarajan Salai"** (vertical, ×2).
  - Partially cut labels top-left: "…th St", "…6th St", "…ross…"; left edge: "…anghaa", "…i Square".
- Green park polygons (~#A8DFA5) and a cyan water body (~#7FD0E8) at mid-right.
- **"Google"** watermark bottom-left in gray outline text.

### D. Map Pins / Transit Markers
- **Center:** large blue circular walking pin (#0B67C4 / #1666C7) with white **walking person** icon, drop tail, and small blue dot beneath.
- **Left-of-center:** maroon/dark-plum (#4A1229) rounded-square bus stop marker (~56px) with white **bus front** icon and drop tail; a smaller faded/duplicate gray-mauve bus marker sits behind it.
- **Right:** faded gray-mauve bus stop marker (~#9B8A93).
- Two tiny dark dots on the road (live vehicle dots).

### E. Bottom Sheet (white, rounded ~24px top corners, draggable handle)
- Small gray drag handle bar centered at top (~48×5px, #C9C9C9).
- **Line 1:** "You are in ↗ **Ramapuram**." — black text, ~19px semibold; arrow icon ↗ before city name; "Ramapuram" bold with black underline.
- **Line 2:** "No buses available around you." — same size/weight, regular black.

### F. Search Bar
- Full-width pill (inset ~16px sides, height ~72px, fully rounded) with **pink→orange gradient**: left #D4008F → mid #E9445A → right #FF7A00.
- Left: white text **“Search “B**” (typing placeholder/cursor), ~22px semibold.
- Right: white **magnifying glass** icon (~28px).

### G. Main Bottom Navigation (white pill card, rounded ~36px, floating)
Five items:
1. **Home** — red/orange stacked-tiles icon (#E8442E), bold red label (active).
2. **Tickets** — gray (#8A8A8E) ticket/bookmark icon.
3. **BUS TICKET** — elevated blue circle (gradient #4A6CF7→#3B4FE0, ~72px) with white bus icon + ticket icon, small white uppercase label "BUS TICKET" inside.
4. **Pass** — gray card/pass icon.
5. **Account** — gray person icon.

### H. Peek Row (bottom, partially cut off — scrolled horizontally)
Segmented category chips with labels and images (partially visible):
- **Bus** (bus photo, dark), **Metro** (gray image tile, underlined — selected, black underline bar), **Train** (image tile), **Auto** (image tile), partial next item at far right edge.
- Labels ~16px semibold black.

## 2) Layout Structure
- Full-screen map canvas; floating circular/pill controls overlaid.
- Draggable bottom sheet (~38% height) containing status text, gradient search pill, nav pill, category chip row.
- Google Maps default gestures: pinch zoom, pan; stops toggleable via "Stops" switch; location FAB re-centers.

## 3) Color Palette
- Map base: #F7F7F5; roads #FFFFFF/#E8E8E6; park #A8DFA5; water #7FD0E8
- Stops pill: #262629 (black)
- Toggle: #1A73E8 blue
- Walk pin: #1666C7
- Bus marker: #4A1229; faded markers: #9B8A93
- Sheet/nav: #FFFFFF; text #111111; inactive gray #8A8A8E; handle #C9C9C9
- Gradient: #D4008F → #E9445A → #FF7A00
- Bus Ticket circle: #4A6CF7→#3B4FE0
- Home icon/label: #E8442E

## 4) Icons
- Walking person (white), bus front (white), close ✕ (black), crosshair (black), search (white), tiles (red), ticket (gray), bus+ticket (white), pass card (gray), person (gray), ↗ arrow (black).

## 5) Typography
- Font: Google Sans / Roboto family.
- "Stops": ~17px bold white.
- Map labels: ~13–14px, #7B7B7B.
- Sheet text: ~19px medium; bold for "Ramapuram".
- Search text: ~22px semibold white.
- Nav labels: ~13px semibold.
- Chip labels: ~16px semibold black.
